subject: CareCo discovery — unit-econ deep-dive & next-steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@carecohealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@carecohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: unit economics details from today's discovery

Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and asks so we can put together a concrete pricing / payback model for the CareCo pilot: 

1) Primary feature scope: summarize — clinical triage assistant for intake + automated discharge summaries (expected to be rolled out to 3 clinics in Q3).
2) Volume assumptions we heard today: ~200k user events/month translating to ~5M tokens/month initially, with heavy tail growth to ~20M tokens/month in 12 months. Please confirm whether the 5M/month is conservative or representative.
3) Target economics: you mentioned a target of $2–$3k per 1M tokens for production (including any discounts for committed volumes). We need your target $/1M token range so we can map to feature-level unit economics.
4) Key business metrics you want tied to the model: CAC payback target (months), feature-level gross margin target vs inference-only cost, and acceptable latency (p95 sub-800ms per request).

What I'll do next: Marissa will model three scenarios (pilot conservative, target growth, aggressive scale) with $/1M token sensitivity and the resulting $/feature and CAC payback curves. Connor will prepare a draft SOW + committed volume pricing band we can use for procurement.

Attachments: please see referenced token estimate template (we'll fill in with your confirmed numbers).

Can you confirm by EOD Tuesday: the 5M tokens/month baseline and the desired CAC payback horizon (in months)? Also attach any internal SLA/latency requirements or procurement timing constraints.

Thanks — talk soon.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: CareCo_token_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Redwood_Terms_v2.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Alex Nguyen <alex@carecohealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@carecohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: unit economics details from today's discovery

Ben — thanks for the summary and for looping Marissa / Connor in. Quick answers below: 

- Baseline tokens: 5M tokens/month is what we modeled for Q3 once ingest pipelines are live — that's representative for pilot (3 clinics). We expect a conservative adoption curve so treat that baseline as "low" rather than optimistic.
- 12-month view: ~18–22M tokens/month if we push across more of our network, so your growth scenarios are aligned.
- Target $/1M tokens: we'd like to see scenarios at $3k, $2k, and $1.5k per 1M tokens so we can understand thresholds. Procurement will push back on anything above $3k unless there's a clear ROI.
- CAC payback: target 9–12 months for feature-driven expansion; finance prefers under 12 months.
- Latency: p95 under 700ms ideally, hard max 1s for the triage calls.

I'm attaching the high-level usage export you asked for and our internal procurement calendar (PDF). Let me know if you need anything else before Marissa sends the scenarios.

Best,
Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Product, CareCo Health
alex@carecohealth.com

Attachments: CareCo_usage_export_May2026.csv (csv stub), CareCo_procurement_timeline.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal — modeling scenarios for CareCo (action items)

Ben / Connor — I pulled the baseline inputs from Ben's note and Alex's reply. Plan below: 

- Deliverable A (by 2026-05-13): three scenario sheets showing $/1M token mapping to $/feature (triage session and discharge summary per active patient), gross margin before overhead (inference cost only), and CAC payback months given CareCo's conversion/ARR assumptions.
- Deliverable B (by 2026-05-14): a one-page slide that highlights the breakpoints where margin flips positive and where CAC payback meets 9/12 month targets. Will call out sensitivity to latency-driven SKU changes (e.g., higher throughput/replica needs).

Inputs I'm using: baseline 5M tokens/mo, growth to 20M/mo in 12 months, token price scenarios at $3k/$2k/$1.5k per 1M. Alex's latency target (p95 <700ms) will be reflected as a constraint that can increase cost ~10–20% for higher SLA.

Connor — please draft a commit band: 0–10M, 10–50M, 50M+ with example unit prices so we have a procurement-ready sheet. Ben — want me to include a conservative estimate for any prefix caching savings (we can assume 10% token reduction on triage flows)?

I'll attach the scenario workbook once ready.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: (will attach CareCo_econ_scenarios.xlsx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alex Nguyen <alex@carecohealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CareCo discovery — unit-econ deep-dive & next-steps

Alex / Ben / Marissa — attaching the initial draft commit bands and a quick SOW outline. Notes: 

- Commit bands (draft):
  * 0–10M tokens/mo: list price $3,500 per 1M tokens (pilot band)
  * 10–50M tokens/mo: $2,000 per 1M tokens
  * 50M+ tokens/mo: $1,400 per 1M tokens

- With caching and batching we should model an effective token reduction of 8–12% for triage flows; I'll include a conservative 10% in scenario A.
- Estimated $/feature (triage session): at 5M tokens/mo baseline and $2k per 1M tokens, triage feature cost = ~$0.20 per session assuming 1.2k sessions/day across 3 clinics (detailed calc in attached spreadsheet).
- CAC payback: with your stated conversion and average revenue per clinic, the model shows a 10–11 month payback in the $2k per 1M scenario.

Next steps: Marissa to attach the detailed workbook; Ben — happy to set a procurement intro call with your procurement lead next week. Alex — can you confirm procurement availability (Tue/Wed mornings) and whether CareCo would consider a 12-month committed band?

Connor O'Brien
Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai

Attachments: CareCo_token_estimate_v1.xlsx (filled draft), Redwood_Terms_v2.pdf (redline stub)
